# NodeZero® Packaging

List prices in US dollars, per asset. **Core, Pro,** and **Elite** are annual subscriptions with **unlimited testing**: each asset counts once a year, however often you test it. **Flex** is for occasional testing: each asset counts every time it’s tested

NodeZero Flex

Episodic Autonomous Penetration Testing

$15

per asset,

per test

An asset is any server, workstation, network device, cloud resource, or internet-facing service that NodeZero identifies in your environment. NodeZero matches on hostnames, IP addresses, domains, certificates, and other identifiers. A machine that shows up under several names or addresses counts as one asset.

See [Terms](https://horizon3.ai/terms-of-service/) for more information.

Assets count each time they are tested. 12-month term. No add-ons.

[Get a quote](https://horizon3.ai/contact-us/)

Autonomous Pentesting

Internal, external, cloud (AWS and Azure) and Kubernetes pentests, plus Active Directory password audits, insider threat and phishing impact testing. Every weakness comes with Fix Actions and 1-click Verify.

Where most teams start

Autonomous Pentesting

Internal, external, cloud (AWS and Azure) and Kubernetes pentests, plus Active Directory password audits, insider threat and phishing impact testing. Every weakness comes with Fix Actions and 1-click Verify.

Continuous Testing

Schedule recurring pentests, and track trends in impacts, weaknesses and time to remediate with Threat Informed Perspectives.

Rapid Response

Actionable intelligence on the riskiest emerging threats, discovered or vetted by the Horizon3 expert offensive security team, so you can find and fix your exposure before attackers exploit it.

Tripwires™

Deception deployed automatically in attack paths to secure the exploitable vulnerabilities NodeZero discovers and proves. Real-time alerts give you the details of any access attempt.

High Value Targeting™

Assesses your high-value targets (hosts, identities, data), prioritizes pentests against them, and uses LLMs to surface the business risk in the results.

Advanced Data Pilfering™

Uncovers credentials in overlooked sources using LLM-driven pattern recognition, file analysis and reasoning.

Threat Actor Intelligence™

Maps findings to known threat actors, so you can see which groups are most likely to exploit your environment.

Vulnerability Prioritization

Correlates findings from scanners like Tenable, Rapid7 and Qualys with the NodeZero attack graph to show which ones are actually exploitable.
